Our Services Get the Latest in Battery Tech & Innovation Get updates on the latest battery technologies, EV trends, and U.S. electrolyte innovation—straight to your inbox. ​ Explore More Automat Solutions Announces Commissioning of Agile Production Line [San Leandro, CA], August 5, 2024 – Automat Solutions, a U.S.-based battery electrolyte development company, has successfully established its first agile electrolyte production line. This new production line is capable of flexibly producing electrolytes with varying formulations, with output ranging from 40 to 400 kg per batch. Together, the platforms create an integrated workspace for electrolyte discovery, formulation evaluation, literature review, and data-driven battery materials decision-making. Accountability. Service. Teamwork. Our Mission At Automat Solutions, our mission is to revolutionize battery performance through AI-powered research and U.S.-manufactured electrolyte solutions. We aim to accelerate the transition to sustainable energy by delivering high-performance, customizable electrolytes for electric vehicles, grid storage, and next-gen battery systems. Values Quality Quality is a core value that guides everything from our formulations to our customer support to ensure reliable, high-performance outcomes at every stage Innovation We constantly push the boundaries of materials science, leveraging AI and automation to transform how electrolytes are developed and delivered. Expert Support Exceptional client service is fundamental as we prioritize responsiveness, collaboration, and tailored support to ensure our partners achieve their technical and commercial goals Efficiency Efficiency drives everything from accelerating electrolyte development with AI and robotics to ensuring fast turnaround times and streamlined support for our partners. Our Advantages Artificial Intelligence Leveraging proprietary AI and large language models (LLMs) to accelerate battery research, material discovery, and product development in energy storage technologies. Experimentation Automated high-throughput robotics accelerate battery electrolyte discovery, enabling faster development of next-generation, high-performance energy storage solutions. Industry Trust Partnered with leading cell developers and battery manufacturers to deliver high-performance electrolyte solutions and scalable R&D support. Customization Empowering battery manufacturers to rapidly iterate electrolyte designs and scale production with speed and precision.
